---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with the ATT&CK LinkML schema or its artefacts
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear description of what went wrong.

**Where?**
The schema element, generated artefact (`project/...`) or release asset involved, and the ATT&CK object (its STIX `id` and the bundle) it fails on, if any. A problem in ATT&CK's data belongs with [MITRE](https://github.com/mitre-attack/attack-stix-data/issues), and one in the ATT&CK Data Model with [its maintainers](https://github.com/mitre-attack/attack-data-model/issues).

**To reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior, including the exact command and input data.

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen, and the ATT&CK Data Model page or the ATT&CK v20.0 data that says so, if any.

## Environment

- OS:
- Python version (`uv run python --version`):
- `attack` release, or the commit you built from:
- LinkML version (`uv run linkml --version`):

**Additional context**
Logs, tracebacks, or validation output.

## AI Assistance

If you used AI tools while preparing this issue, you are still the author and responsible for understanding, verifying, and defending your submission. Don't dump LLM output into this issue without curation. See the [AI Covenant](https://github.com/lmodel/attack/blob/main/AI_COVENANT.md) for details.
